'''Etienne Dorn''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Kraken's Retreat''' in the '''Los''' system of the [[Colonia]] region. Formerly the lead shield engineer for Kraken Shield Specialists, he now operates a secluded workshop supported largely by robots.<ref name="edwiki-etienne">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Etienne_Dorn Etienne Dorn], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Etienne offers '''Grade 5''' engineering for ten module families spanning core internals, scanners, sensors, and weapons.<ref name="inara-etienne">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/23/ Etienne Dorn — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Los
* '''Facility:''' Kraken's Retreat
* '''Region:''' [[Colonia]]
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship core internals, scanners, sensors, and weapons
* '''Referral required:''' [[Liz Ryder]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

Kraken's Retreat is in the Colonia region rather than the Bubble. Commanders must therefore account for the inter-regional journey when preparing a workshop visit.

== Access requirements ==

Access to Etienne Dorn has three stages:<ref name="inara-etienne" /><ref name="edwiki-etienne" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Liz Ryder]] to receive his referral.
# Reach the '''Trade rank of Dealer or higher'''.
# Provide '''25 Occupied Escape Pods''' at Kraken's Retreat.

The referral, Trade rank, and cargo contribution are separate conditions. The complete ordered process and Occupied Escape Pod acquisition guidance belong to [[Unlocking Etienne Dorn]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Etienne Dorn increases by crafting modifications at his workshop.<ref name="inara-etienne" />

Higher reputation opens the grades that Etienne supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-etienne" />

The available conventional modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add four Operations-era services to Etienne's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-etienne" />

* '''Long Range Detailed''' [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-long-range">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Balanced''' [[Power Distributor]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-balanced">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/208/ Power Distributor — Balanced], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Support Focused''' [[Power Distributor]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-support">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/209/ Power Distributor — Support Focused], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Enduring Feedback''' Rail Gun engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-enduring">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/210/ Rail Gun — Enduring Feedback], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Exact modifiers, costs, and compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Etienne Dorn blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Current Engineer records do not identify another Engineer whose discovery requirement comes directly from Etienne Dorn. His active referral branch therefore ends at his workshop.<ref name="inara-etienne" />
